summary: Teucrium Commodity Trust filed an 8-K on August 31, 2026, disclosing that sponsor Teucrium Trading, LLC authorized the Teucrium Wheat Fund (WEAT, NYSE Arca) to invest discretionarily in KC Hard Red Winter Wheat futures on the CBOT and Hard Red Spring Wheat futures on MGEX, effective immediately. The Fund's objective, Benchmark and Benchmark Component Futures Contracts are unchanged; alternative contracts are used only when position limits, accountability levels or price limits constrain benchmark exposure. A Rule 424(b)(3) prospectus supplement was filed the same day. No deal, stake, price or premium is involved; risks include reduced NAV correlation and thinner liquidity.
